page.layout: One column of running text, with a centred heading "Partitio." above a series of paragraphs. Running head at top, page number at top right. Catchword and signature at the foot.

main_text.p: meo iudicio, corrigitur à iust.[?] L.ult.C, eod.tit.
main_text.head: Partitio.
main_text.p: Aquæ & ignis.) Enunc.1. Aquæ & ignis interdictio æquiparatur morti.
Emancipatus esset.) Sequitur 2. Emancipatio, cum de sui iure agitur, comparatur morti.
Non pertinent ad legem.) Sequitur 3. Casus omnes quibus suus heres post testatoris mortem nascitur, ad legem Velleam[?] non pertinent.
Ad similitudinem mortis.) Sequitur 4. Quod de casu mortis in Aquiliana formula dictum est, idem in emancipatione & deportatione valet.
Apud hostes habebat.) Sequitur 5. Servitutis hostium & mortis, par unaq; ratio est.
Quamuis post mortem patris.) Sequitur 6. Qui post patris mortem apud hostē moritur, ipso captivitatis momēto, ac proinde patre vivo, mortuus intelligitur.
Multos casus rumpendi.) Sequitur 7. Lex Vellea multas rumpēdorum testamētorum occasiones præcidit.

page.notes: Running head and page number are clear. The catchword "ba," and signature "o 4" are at the foot. The word after "iust." at the top of the page is uncertain: the long s may be read as f, so it is marked [?]. "Velleam" is joined from a line-end split ("Vel" / "leam") with no printed hyphen, so it is doubtful and marked [?]. No marginal notes or Greek or Hebrew are printed on this page.
